summary: The Cracker Factory is an American television movie directed by Burt Brinckerhoff. Its teleplay by Richard Shapiro adapts the best-selling 1977 novel by Joyce Rebeta-Burditt. The film was broadcast by ABC on March 16, 1979.
one_line: A 1979 ABC television movie directed by Burt Brinckerhoff, adapted from Joyce Rebeta-Burditt's 1977 bestselling novel.
